answer: A reef forge: each identity gets one plot on a public reef and must grow a yarrow plant there, one verified stage at a time, with each stage forged into the plant's stem by a different reef peer who watched the work happen. A fake can plant a yarrow, but it cannot fake the slow growth — each stage takes a real epoch and a real witness — and a farm cannot bulk-grow a thousand plants because each plot needs its own water, its own space on the reef, and its own witnesses; a thousand fakes need a thousand separately grown yarrows.
